# Continual-ARC: hollow rectangle fill rule

For tasks with several hollow, one-cell-thick rectangular/square outlines on a uniform background, preserve the outlines and all exterior cells, and fill each enclosed interior according to its interior side length:

- Odd-by-odd interiors (1x1, 3x3, 5x5 demonstrated) become color 7.
- Even-by-even interiors (2x2 demonstrated; test confirmed 4x4 and 6x6) become color 2.

This rule is independent of outline color and background color in the demonstrations. The interiors initially contain background-colored cells. Distinguish the inner dimensions from the full outline bounds, and change only the strictly interior cells; in particular, include every interior row up to but excluding the bottom border.

Evidence: two demos in task-e2c946bf. Demo 1 showed 1x1, 3x3, and 5x5 cavities filled 7. Demo 2 showed 1x1 and 3x3 cavities filled 7, while 2x2 cavities filled 2. The solved test showed 6x6 and 4x4 interiors filled 2, and 3x3 filled 7. Earlier attempts failed from using 7 for even-sized interiors and then leaving the last interior row unfilled.
